tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every surface (Athelstan --color-canvas). Never put body copy directly on it in the prototype; text sits on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Stable reading surface: explanations, source, evidence, notes forms. Opaque on purpose; glass never sits behind long reading text.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet panels inside a surface: snippet lists, chain rows, collapsed details.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, sheets and the glossary card when the glass fallback is active.

tokens.name: surface-navigation
tokens.usage: Opaque fallback for the masthead, file panel and tab bar when backdrop blur is unavailable or reduced transparency is requested.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected file row, active destination pill, current map node fill.

tokens.name: surface-code
tokens.usage: Source viewer and snippet backgrounds (Boozer addition). Code is always on this, never on glass.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default 1px rule between rows and around reading surfaces.

tokens.name: border-inner
tokens.usage: Rules inside a surface (between list rows, between sections of the file workspace).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines and the rim of a focused reading surface. Holds 3:1 against `surface` in neither theme on its own; pair with a fill or text label.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-subtle`, `surface-code` and `canvas` in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy and hints on `surface` and `surface-subtle`; also the ink of `Your note` text.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata (line counts, snapshot time, step counts) on `surface` and `surface-subtle`. Meets 4.5:1 on both.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Athelstan's lightest ink, kept exactly. Light value is about 4.1:1 on white, so use it only for 16px+ text or purely decorative labels; never for counts, gaps or warnings.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Boozer's green (Athelstan brand/signal green). Fills of the one primary action per view, selection rules, focus ring. Not a text colour in light; use `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of a `brand` fill; deep estate green in light.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Green text and icons (links, active nav label) on `surface`, `surface-subtle` and glass chrome. Athelstan's --glass-brand-ink, the 4.5:1-safe step of brand.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brand-ink: active destination, selected chip.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a `brand` fill. Dark theme uses near-black because the light signal green can't carry white text.

tokens.name: fact-ink
tokens.usage: 'Found in code' — parser facts: relationships, counts, import lines. Athelstan --color-attention. Solid 1px border in the same ink.

tokens.name: fact-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of fact tags and the 'At a glance' facts row.

tokens.name: ai-ink
tokens.usage: 'AI explanation — may be wrong'. Tag text, dashed border of AI blocks, citation chips. Derived from Okabe & Ito reddish purple, darkened for text. Never used for parser facts.

tokens.name: ai-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of the AI tag and the streaming cursor area.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: 'Your note' tag text and the note card rim. Warm paper ink so the user's own words never look like Boozer's output.

tokens.name: note-paper
tokens.usage: Background of a note card (opaque paper).

tokens.name: gap-ink
tokens.usage: 'Not analysed' / possibly incomplete. Counts of skipped files, unresolved imports, unsupported patterns; stale citations; moved/stale notes. Athelstan --color-warning. Dotted border.

tokens.name: gap-subtle
tokens.usage: Background behind gap counts and warning notices.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Errors: explanation failed, model missing, source unavailable, parse error. Athelstan --color-danger. Always with a sentence saying what still works.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of error notices.

tokens.name: external-ink
tokens.usage: Anything that would leave this computer (cloud comparison). Alias-equivalent of gap-ink; always with the word 'online' and the globe glyph.

tokens.name: glass-chrome
tokens.usage: Restrained glass fill for the masthead, file panel and tab bar (Athelstan restrained --glass-bg-medium). Chrome only.

tokens.name: glass-elevated
tokens.usage: Restrained glass for popovers and the glossary card (Athelstan restrained --glass-bg-elevated).

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: 1px rim of a glass strip (Athelstan --glass-border).

tokens.name: glass-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline inside glass chrome (Athelstan --glass-rule).

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on glass rows and pills (Athelstan --glass-hover-bg).

tokens.name: glass-selected
tokens.usage: Active destination pill on glass (Athelstan --glass-selected-bg).

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Brand tint on glass: active file row in the panel (Athelstan --glass-tint, resolved from color-mix).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet on narrow screens (Athelstan --glass-scrim).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus ring, 2px offset. Brand green holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: page-heading
styles.usage: One per destination: the project name on Overview, the file name in the workspace header. Athelstan --type-page-heading.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: Question headings in the file workspace and Overview ('What does this file do?'). Larger than Athelstan's 15px section size because these are the beginner's map.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Sub-headings inside a section; panel titles. Athelstan --type-section-size.

styles.name: reading-lead
styles.usage: The everyday-words summary at the top of an explanation, and the one-sentence Overview finding.
styles.sample: This file keeps the list of plants and saves changes.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Explanations, hints, Overview copy, empty and error states. The beginner reading size; never smaller for anything a first-time user must understand.
styles.sample: Files that import this one could be affected if it changes.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Lists, rows and controls in chrome (file panel, connection rows). One step up from Athelstan's 13px body for readability.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button and pill labels. Athelstan --type-control-size rounded up.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata and tags: line counts, step badges, snapshot time.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the file panel ('STARTING CANDIDATES'). Athelstan sidebar group label.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: Relative file paths everywhere, so users can find the same file in their coding tool. Never truncate the file name; truncate leading folders with a middle ellipsis.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Source viewer and snippets, with line numbers in text-muted.

styles.name: code-small
styles.usage: Import specifiers and evidence chains inside rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gap inside a section.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Narrow-screen gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Reading surface padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between question sections in the file workspace.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of a destination.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Overview hero spacing on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Provenance tags and count badges (Athelstan --radius-chip).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Opaque controls inside reading surfaces: line-range inputs, the copy-path button.

tokens.name: radius-surface
tokens.usage: Source viewer, snippets, note paper: opaque reading surfaces.

tokens.name: glass-radius-small
tokens.usage: File rows in the glass panel (Athelstan --glass-radius-small).

tokens.name: glass-radius-control
tokens.usage: Destination pills and segmented controls (Athelstan --glass-radius-control).

tokens.name: glass-radius-button
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons (Athelstan --glass-radius-button).

tokens.name: glass-radius-surface
tokens.usage: Reading surfaces that sit on the canvas: workspace sections, Overview cards (Athelstan --glass-radius-surface).

tokens.name: glass-radius-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers and the evidence sheet (Athelstan --glass-radius-overlay).

tokens.name: glass-radius-panel
tokens.usage: Narrow-screen tab bar and full-height sheets (Athelstan --glass-radius-panel).

tokens.name: shadow-subtle
tokens.usage: Reading surfaces on the canvas (Athelstan --glass-shadow-subtle).

tokens.name: shadow-medium
tokens.usage: Masthead and file panel (Athelstan --glass-shadow-medium).

tokens.name: shadow-elevated
tokens.usage: Popovers, the evidence sheet, the narrow tab bar (Athelstan --glass-shadow-elevated).

layout.note: Shell proportions. Masthead height and panel width come from Athelstan's shell; the rest are Boozer's reading constraints.

tokens.name: masthead-height
tokens.usage: Top strip with project identity and destinations (Athelstan --athelstan-shell-height).

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Explore file panel. Athelstan's sidebar is 232px; Boozer adds 32px because relative paths are longer than nav labels.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Collapsed file panel when the evidence panel is open below 1280px.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of explanation and Overview copy (about 75 characters at 16px).

tokens.name: evidence-width
tokens.usage: Source/evidence panel beside the workspace on desktop.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Narrow-screen bottom tab bar (Athelstan tab bar).

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target on narrow screens.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default button height; 40px comfortable for the one primary action.
